items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Lloyd Phillips record, for instance, is quite nice

ctx.x: know, and good songs, but you've got to -- I don't know, you know -- you got to get a band that can -- you got to perform a miracle. Basie made a good thing out of "Shiny Stockings" and stuff like that. (Inaudible) been recorded with Basie's band, too. You never know. Some other bands (inaudible) put on the market might, you know. You can't tell. But you got to sit down and be able to really create something new and different like Herb ________ did with his little outfit. Not him, not that style, but he did reach…

Well, the stuff he's got, just from my experience of it, would not be too easy to sell. You know, I mean, you ________ Lloyd Phillips record, for instance, is quite nice, but you'd have a job selling it. The record with all those tenors.
The name wouldn't carry it, would it?
